purpose: Baseline registration with a run-scoped unique email
setup: Reset seed or confirm the generated email does not exist
name: HW06 Register User
test_action: POST /api/register once with the generatedEmail value
verification: Response contains the success message and a positive integer id; optionally find the same email through the admin users API
teardown: Delete the returned user id with the admin users API, or reset SQLite after the data file finishes

purpose: Stable duplicate-email input based on a seeded identity
setup: Reset SQLite and confirm test@eshop.com is the seeded user with id 2
name: Duplicate Seed User
test_action: POST /api/register without modifying the fixed email
verification: Response rejects the duplicate and no additional user is created
teardown: No row should be created; reset SQLite if verification shows an unexpected mutation

purpose: Check replay behavior inside one isolated run
setup: Generate one new email and store it as generatedEmail
name: HW06 Replay User
test_action: Send the same generatedEmail twice: first request creates it, second request checks duplicate handling
verification: Only one user exists for generatedEmail and the second response is a rejection
teardown: Delete the id returned by the first request, or reset SQLite
